The connector handler additionally treated native Request.body ReadableStream as parsed JSON, silently discarding draft configuration.
prevention_rule: Replay actual writer output against versioned Postgres constraints and test the active browser API with native Request objects, not only pre-parsed request doubles. Preserve RLS, ACL, immutable lineage, idempotency and provider activation proof.
